notes: Scores the candidate's equation() by BFGS-fitting its ten parameters on the task's train.csv and reporting the mean squared error, exactly as CoEvo's in-loop evaluator does.
The paper metrics are NMSE on the held-out test_id/test_ood splits (CoEvo test_res.py); the in-loop train MSE recorded here is the search signal, not the reported benchmark number.
